about: The Copernicus DEM GLO-90 tiles read by scripts/screening_terrain.py. The tiles themselves are kept outside the project (the screening cache folder); every run checks them against the sha256 below. 'fetched' is when the file was downloaded; 'checked' is how its content was compared with the AWS object.
dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (COP-DEM_GLO-90-DGED, 2021 release): 1 x 1 deg Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs on AWS Open Data, s3://copernicus-dem-90m (float32, 3 arc-seconds, metres above the EGM2008 geoid)
licence: Licence for COP-DEM-GLO-90-F Global 90m Full, Free & Open (pages 19-21 of the PDF)
